name: MoeGroupScoreAggregationAndMasking
reference:
import torch

def run(scores):
    num_groups = scores.shape[0]
    group_size = scores.shape[-1]
    masked_scores = scores.clone()
    top_k = max(1, group_size // 2)
    topk_vals, _ = torch.topk(scores, k=top_k, dim=-1)
    threshold = topk_vals[:, -1].unsqueeze(-1)
    mask = scores >= threshold
    masked_scores = scores * mask.to(scores.dtype)
    return masked_scores, mask
description: MoE group score aggregation and masking. Aggregates expert scores within groups and applies masking. Returns (masked_scores, group_mask). Pure PyTorch: group score aggregation + top-k masking.
